review.why: Researches the space before a build: local projects, competitors, forums, libraries and platform features, in three depths.
review.summary: Pre-build discovery in three depths (focused, wide, deep). It scans the user's local projects for reusable code, researches competitors, forums, reviews, plugin ecosystems and libraries, checks the current platform docs instead of trusting memory, looks ahead, and writes a research brief with a proposed architecture and build phases.
strengths: Reads reviews, issues and forums as demand signals
Tells the agent to check current platform docs, not training data
Brief template ends with risks and open questions
cautions: Tied to the author's setup: a specific notes folder, artifact path and a Cloudflare checklist
No citation or verification discipline: it says it is not for fact-checked reports
Product and developer discovery, not general research
